description: This Java class implements JwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider for handling JWTs, specifically for extracting authorization subjects based on issuer configuration, with support for Google JWTs.

classes.name: DittoJwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider
classes.description: Provides authorization subjects from JWTs based on issuer configuration, immutable class.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance with issuer configuration, checks for null argument.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Extracts authorization subjects from a given JsonWebToken, throws exception if issuer unsupported.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare based on jwtSubjectIssuersConfig.
